game.name: Condemned (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: A long dark corridor, barely lit by an almost suppurating light. Where the hell is that junkie? And then a scream... Welcome to the sordid world of Condemned on Xbox 360, a first-person shooter. Well, shooting... when you have ammunition. Because in this dark and gloomy universe, it's mostly with bladed weapons that you make your way, getting deeper and deeper into a horror with not always very human features...
